description:

Position Summary
  
  
Level: Software Engineer II
  
  
As a Software Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver backend and front-end engineering solutions that support enterprise-scale applications and client transformations. You will apply experience in Java, Spring Boot, and Angular to build maintainable, secure, and scalable solutions while contributing to delivery quality, process improvement, and innovation. This role offers the opportunity to work across modern engineering practices, strengthen technical depth, and support high-quality outcomes in a collaborative environment.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As a Software Engineer II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for …
  
  

* Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and application programming interfaces using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
* Building and enhancing Angular applications using TypeScript, reactive programming patterns, and integration with RESTful services
* Supporting solution design decisions by evaluating technical approaches, identifying risks, and contributing to secure, maintainable, and performant implementations
* Performing testing, debugging, defect management, documentation, and production issue resolution across the software development lifecycle
* Contributing to process improvements, automation, delivery metric tracking, knowledge sharing, and development of tools or accelerators that improve project outcomes

The Team
  
  
Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise . We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
  
  
Education: BE/ B.Tech /M.C.A./ M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university
  
  
Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune
  
  
Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST
  
  
**Qualifications**
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* Core JAVA & Backend engineering
* 4 - 7 years of strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8 +) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
* Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
* Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure , and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade-offs
* Spring & Enterprise Frameworks:
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture , with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
* Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
* Experience implementing security and cloud-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud ( e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
* Strong understanding of data persistence , including RDBMS & SQL (or NOSQL), normalization , complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
* Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging , including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
* Angular
* 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in Angular
* Strong hands-on experience building scalable and production-grade angular applications using TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
* Strong understanding of Angular fundamentals, including components , modules , services , dependency injection (DI) , routing , guards, and forms (template / reactive - driven).
* Proficiency with RxJS and reactive programming, including observables , operators , subscription management and effective error handling patterns.
* Experience implementing state management patterns ( e.g. , NgRx or equivalent), including separation of UI state vs domain state
* Strong UI engineering fundamentals including HTML/ CSS, responsive design, accessibility considerations and cross-browser compatibility
* Hands-on experience integrating Angular applications with backend services via RESTful APIs ( GraphQL where applicable ) , including contract-driven integration ( OpenAPI /Swagger), pagination, error handling
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization flows in the UI using OAuth2/OIDC and JWT, including interceptors, route guards, and role-based UI behavior.
* Strong testing & Debugging skills with unit tests (Jasmine/Karma/Jest) and end-to-end automation (Playwright/Cypress), ensuring stability and maintainability.
* Experience with Angular performance optimization, including lazy loading, change detection strategies, efficient rendering, and bundle optimization
* Familiarity with Angular CLI, environment configuration, build pipelines, and deployment optimization
* Soft Skills
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
* Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
* Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding

Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* Certification (JAVA):
* Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
* Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
* Agile Development and Collaboration
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
* Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
* Awareness of any of the industry domains

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. At Xplor Mariana Tek, our mission is to simplify fitness studio management by making it approachable, effortless, and focused on the people who matter most.

Our core values - Make Life Simple, Build for People, Move with Purpose, and Create Lasting Communities are key to who we are and what guides us from how we hire to how we recognize our team members

We’re looking for a full stack senior software engineer who can design and write code in a multi-tenant SaaS environment. The candidate needs to be highly collaborative, productive in a dynamic development environment and be willing to utilize AI in their day-to-day work.

* Collaboration with teammates and other functions in a geographically distributed remote environment
* Hands-on development with Python, Django, Ember and PostgreSQL
* Creating well-designed, testable, efficient systems following company processes and industry best practices
* Leading technical design initiatives and efforts
* Troubleshooting and resolving software defects
* Utilizing PRs as a path to teach and learn
* Shared ownership for team dynamics, processes and growth

* JavaScript framework experience
* Git / GitHub and PR-based delivery
* Use of Docker for local development
* Writing and maintaining robust tests
* Willingness to utilize AI in day-to-day work

Its patented artificial intelligence accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows to read, understand, and make real-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises, including one-third of the Fortune 500, use AppZen’s invoice, expense, and card transaction solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their businesses. To learn more, visit us at
www.appzen.com
.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an
**AI/ML Engineer**
with 1–3 years of experience to join our growing AI team. In this role, you will build and ship the
**LLM-powered and agentic features**
that read, understand and make decisions on invoices, expense reports and card transactions for some of the world’s largest finance teams. You will work alongside senior AI/ML engineers, data scientists and product managers to take features from prototype to production, and own them once they are live. If you enjoy turning the latest advances in LLMs and agents into reliable and measurable products, AppZen is the place for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **LLM & Agent Development:**
  Build and improve LLM-powered features and multi-step agentic workflows (e.g., using LangGraph) that extract, validate and reason over invoices, receipts, expense reports and card transactions.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):**
  Build retrieval pipelines (chunking, embeddings, vector search and re-ranking) that give models the right policy, vendor and transaction context to make accurate financial decisions.
* **Tool Use & Structured Outputs:**
  Implement function calling and API integrations so that models can reliably query internal services and ERP/AP systems, and return validated, structured (JSON) outputs.
* **Evaluation & Quality:**
  Build evaluation datasets, metrics and automated test suites to measure accuracy, hallucination rate, latency and cost, and use the results to improve prompts, retrieval and models.
* **Production Engineering:**
  Package and deploy models and services using Docker and CI/CD pipelines, add monitoring and logging, and keep them reliable, scalable and cost-efficient in production.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with senior engineers, data scientists and product managers to turn customer and business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions, and contribute to code reviews and design discussions.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* **Professional Experience:**
  1–3 years of experience building and deploying ML/AI solutions in production, including at least 1 year of hands-on work on LLM-based applications.
* **Programming:**
  Strong
  **Python**
  skills, with experience writing clean, tested, production-grade code and building REST APIs (e.g., FastAPI or Flask).

  Hands-on experience with
  **LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex**
  or similar frameworks, and with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) or open-source models.
* **RAG & Vector Databases:**
  Practical experience building RAG pipelines using vector databases such as
  **Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS**
  .
* **Prompting & Structured Outputs:**
  Good understanding of prompting techniques (few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, ReAct) and of getting reliable structured outputs and function calls from LLMs.
* **ML Fundamentals:**
  Solid grounding in ML and NLP fundamentals, with working experience in
  **PyTorch**
  or a similar framework. Exposure to fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA) is a plus.
* **MLOps & Cloud:**
  Working knowledge of Docker, Git and CI/CD, and experience deploying on a cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure). Familiarity with LLM observability tools (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases) is a plus.
* **Good to Have:**
  Experience with document AI (OCR, invoice or receipt data extraction) or with finance, accounts payable or expense data.
* **Education:**

This is a strategic and hands-on role where you will provide direction and governance over our Adobe Analytics platform as assessment and implementation work progresses, architect the web-to-warehouse data pipeline, define how we measure performance in an era of AI-driven search, and serve as the connective tissue between digital strategy, Marketing Ops/GTM, demand marketing, and the Core Data team.

**Adobe Analytics Platform Ownership**
Own the strategy, standards, and governance for our Adobe Analytics implementation. Assessment and implementation work is already underway with an external partner — your role is to direct that work, shape decisions, and ensure what gets built reflects our measurement architecture and long-term needs. Establish and maintain standards for event taxonomy, naming conventions, data layer design, and documentation. Own ongoing platform health and QA.
  
  
**Web-to-Warehouse Data Architecture**
Design and maintain the pipeline from web data capture through to our data warehouse. Identify integration gaps, redundancies, and points of failure across web → core → downstream systems. Partner with data engineering to build clean, durable pipelines — using tools like Snowflake, dbt, or equivalent — so web data is trusted, documented, and joinable with CRM and campaign data.

Build and maintain the KPIs and dashboards that connect web performance to pipeline and revenue — not vanity metrics. Define and implement multi-touch attribution logic that works across the marketing stack. Partner with Sales Ops and the Core Data team to align on a single source of truth.

title: Business Analyst - Risk Domain
description:
**Role & responsibilities**

**BUSINESS ANALYST-Risk Domain | Banking and Financial Services**

**Job Title**

  

Business Analyst - Risk Domain

  

**Function**

  

Risk Management / Business Analysis

**Experience**

  

6-20 years, including 4+ years in risk or financial services

**Role Purpose**

  

The Business Analyst will act as the bridge between risk stakeholders, business teams, data teams, and technology delivery teams. The role is responsible for translating risk-management objectives and regulatory or policy requirements into clear business requirements, process designs, data rules, functional specifications, and testable outcomes. The analyst will support the delivery and enhancement of risk platforms, controls, reporting, and decision-support capabilities across the project lifecycle.

**PRIMARY RISK COVERAGE**

* Credit risk and counterparty credit risk
* Market risk, liquidity risk, or operational risk
* Risk data, controls, regulatory reporting, and model workflows

  

**CORE BA DELIVERABLES**

* Business requirements and user stories
* Process maps, data mappings, and functional specifications
* UAT scenarios, traceability, controls, and stakeholder sign-off

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Business Analysis and Requirements Management**

* Engage risk, finance, compliance, operations, product, data, and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, pain points, controls, and expected outcomes.
* Elicit, analyze, document, prioritize, and validate business and functional requirements using workshops, interviews, document reviews, and process walkthroughs.
* Create business requirement documents, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, decision tables, and requirement traceability matrices.
* Assess current-state processes and systems, define future-state workflows, identify gaps, and recommend practical improvements.

  

**Risk Domain and Regulatory Change**

* Support initiatives covering credit, counterparty, market, liquidity, or operational risk, based on project scope.
* Interpret risk policies, methodologies, control requirements, and regulatory change impacts in partnership with subject-matter experts.
* Translate risk concepts such as exposure, limits, collateral, ratings, probability of default, loss given default, expected credit loss, stress testing, and capital or liquidity measures into implementable requirements where applicable.
* Maintain alignment between business rules, risk calculations, reporting outputs, governance expectations, and audit evidence.

  

**Data, Reporting, and Controls**

* Define data requirements, source-to-target mappings, data quality rules, reconciliations, lineage, exceptions, and control points.
* Collaborate with data architects and engineering teams to validate data availability, definitions, transformations, and report logic.
* Support design and enhancement of risk dashboards, management information, regulatory reports, workflow queues, alerts, and exception monitoring.
* Investigate data or reporting issues, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with the relevant teams.

  

**Delivery, Testing, and Change**

* Work with product owners, project managers, architects, developers, vendors, and QA teams throughout Agile or Waterfall delivery.
* Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning inputs, requirement walkthroughs, dependency tracking, and change-control assessments.
* Prepare test scenarios and expected results, support system integration testing and user acceptance testing, manage defects, and obtain business sign-off.
* Create process guides, training material, release communications, and handover documentation; support implementation and post-release stabilization.

  

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, information systems, mathematics, or a related discipline.
* 4-8 years of business analysis experience, with meaningful exposure to banking, financial services, risk management, or regulatory transformation.
* Proven ability to produce high-quality requirements, process models, user stories, data mappings, test artefacts, and stakeholder presentations.
* Working knowledge of at least one risk area: credit, counterparty credit, market, liquidity, operational, enterprise, or model risk.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and managing requirements from discovery through implementation.

  

**Technical and Analytical Skills**

* Strong SQL and data-analysis capability; ability to investigate data using Excel and interpret large or complex datasets.
* Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience with process and requirement tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Visio, or equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of relational data, data lineage, data quality, APIs, system interfaces, and batch or workflow processes.
* Ability to convert quantitative risk logic and business rules into clear functional requirements and test cases.

  

**Preferred Domain Knowledge**

* Basel framework, IFRS 9 / expected credit loss, stress testing, capital adequacy, liquidity risk, limit management, collateral, or regulatory reporting.
* Risk measures and concepts such as PD, LGD, EAD, RWA, VaR, sensitivities, exposure profiles, CVA, and scenario analysis, depending on role scope.
* Financial products including loans, derivatives, securities, treasury products, and related risk lifecycles.
* Risk governance, internal controls, audit evidence, issue management, and model or data change processes.

  

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Clear, structured communication with the ability to simplify complex risk and technology topics.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* High attention to detail, analytical thinking, ownership, and a control-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver in a dynamic, multi-team environment.
* Curiosity, professional judgment, and willingness to challenge assumptions constructively.

  

**Key Deliverables**

* Current-state and future-state process maps
* Business and functional requirements; epics, features, and user stories
* Data dictionaries, mappings, lineage, and data-quality rules
* Risk calculation or reporting specifications and control requirements
* Traceability matrix, test scenarios, UAT evidence, defect logs, and sign-off packs
* Training, operating procedures, release notes, and implementation support material

  

**Success Measures**

* Requirements are complete, unambiguous, testable, traceable, and approved by the right stakeholders.
* Solutions meet agreed risk, control, data, reporting, and user needs with minimal avoidable rework.
* Risks, dependencies, assumptions, and issues are surfaced early and managed transparently.
* Testing and implementation are supported effectively, with defects resolved and documentation kept current.
* Stakeholders receive clear communication and can adopt the delivered process or capability successfully.

title: Senior Business Analyst, AI
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
Business Analyst, AI
  
  
So, what’s the role all about?
  
  
NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Your idea. Our spark.
  
  
As Business Analyst in the SPARK team, you will be the bridge between the people who have the ideas and the architects and builders who make them real. You will shape raw ideas into clear, prioritised, buildable use cases, and make sure what we build solves the problem it was meant to solve.
  
  
This is a business analysis role with a technical edge. You come from a programming background, so you can read code, query data, test an API, and prototype a quick proof of concept, and you can still run a room full of non-technical stakeholders. You will work closely with the Project Manager, the AI Architects & Builders, and the Change Management & Evangelist.
  
  
How will you make an impact?
  
  
You will own the front end of the incubation pipeline, from the first conversation about an idea through to accepted, measurable outcomes, working hands-on with business teams, architects, and delivery colleagues across regions.
  
  
Discover and Shape Ideas
  
  

* Run discovery sessions, interviews, and workshops with business teams to understand pain points, current processes, and the outcome they want
* Turn ideas into clear use case briefs covering the problem statement, users, expected value, data needs, risks, and success measures
* Assess and rank ideas against business value, feasibility, data readiness, effort, and risk, and give the team a clear recommendation on what to build next
* Build lightweight business cases, including estimated time saved, quality gains, and cost or revenue impact for presentation to Management and AI steering committee

Define What Gets Built
  
  

* Map as-is and to-be processes, and identify where an AI agent, an automation, or a human-in-the-loop step fits best
* Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that architects and builders can build from without guesswork
* Specify expected AI behaviour: what the solution should do, what it should never do, when it hands over to a person, and how answers will be checked for quality
* Prepare test scenarios and evaluation datasets with the builders to measure accuracy, reliability, and usefulness before launch
* Update initiative register

Prototype and Validate
  
  

* Use SQL, Python, or low-code tools to analyse process data, test assumptions, and build simple prototypes that prove an idea before engineering effort is committed
* Review APIs and system documentation to confirm integration feasibility with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365
* Gather early user feedback on prototypes and turn it into prioritised backlog items

Support Delivery and Adoption
  
  

* Own and groom the product backlog, and take part in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives
* Plan and run user acceptance testing with business users, and manage defects and feedback through to closure
* Partner with the Change Management & Evangelist and the Support Helpdesk to turn user questions and feedback into clear improvements

Measure and Share Value
  
  

* Capture baseline metrics before launch and track results afterwards, so every solution can show real impact
* Understand the Software Development Lifecylse to review adoption, continuous business iteration and value realization.
* Maintain the use case library, requirement templates, and playbooks that make the next idea faster to shape

Have you got what it takes?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 5-8 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst in a software, technology, or digital transformation environment
* A programming background: hands-on experience writing code in at least one language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or C#, plus working knowledge of SQL and REST APIs
* Proven skill in requirements engineering: process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceability from need to delivered outcome
* Experience facilitating workshops and aligning senior business stakeholders with technical teams
* Experience working in Agile teams, with tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Working understanding of how large language models, RAG, and AI agents work and what they can and cannot do reliably, with hands-on use of AI assistants in your own work
* Some finance background or knowledge will be a plus
* Strong analytical, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical ideas in plain business language
* Fluency in English

You will have an advantage if you also have:
  
  

* Hands-on experience on AI, GenAI, or automation projects, from use case definition through to production
* Experience with low-code or agent-building tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio or similar
* Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS environments
* Familiarity with evaluating LLM output quality, including test set design and acceptance thresholds
* Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI-PBA
* Experience working across regions and time zones, with teams in International and the Americas

What’s in it for you?
  
  
SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.
  
  
Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!
  
  
Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!
  
  
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Business Analysis
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
In this role, you will:
  
  
**The Avaloq Technical Business Analyst Will**

* Work with stakeholders to understand business goals, processes, scope, users, controls, and expected outcomes.
* Analyse requirements and translate them into clear Avaloq functional and technical requirements.
* Document current and future processes, business rules, data flows, interfaces, system dependencies, and operational impacts.
* Identify gaps between business needs and existing Avaloq functionality.
* Assess the impact of changes on Avaloq modules, configuration, customisation, integrations, data, reports, controls, and support processes.
* Recommend practical solutions that follow Avaloq standards and HSBC technology, risk, and control requirements.
* Work with solution architects and technical teams to define interfaces, data mappings, dependencies, and non-functional requirements.
* Support Avaloq configuration, customisation, workflow, and integration design.
* Produce functional specifications, technical requirement documents, process models, interface specifications, data mappings, and acceptance criteria.
* Support estimation by identifying scope, dependencies, delivery risks, and likely configuration, development, migration, and testing effort.
* Clarify requirements for developers, Avaloq specialists, testers, and vendors during delivery.
* Define test scenarios and expected results for functional, integration, regression, migration, and user acceptance testing.
* Analyse defects and production issues across Avaloq processes, configuration, custom code, interfaces, data, and connected systems.
* Support migration analysis, including data mapping, data quality rules, reconciliation, and migration validation.
* Assess the impact of regulatory, policy, and control changes on Avaloq processes and data.
* Work with Avaloq vendors and internal teams on enhancements, defects, releases, upgrades, and technical dependencies.
* Maintain traceability from the original requirement through design, implementation, testing, approval, and release.
* Communicate decisions, risks, dependencies, progress, and open issues clearly to both business and technical audiences.
* Help prioritise competing requirements and make practical recommendations when scope, timelines, or technical constraints conflict

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:
  
  
**Role profile**
The Avaloq Technical Business Analyst supports Avaloq change and delivery activities across HSBC locations and different system landscapes.
  
  
The role requires strong knowledge of the Avaloq Banking Suite, combined with the ability to understand banking processes and explain technical impacts. The successful candidate can challenge unclear requirements, identify dependencies, document complex processes, and help delivery teams reach a safe and workable outcome.
  
  
**Qualifications And Experience**

* 10+ Yrs of overall experience in technology and 5+ Yrs in executing projects using Avaloq skillset
* Strong hands-on experience with the Avaloq Banking Suite.
* Experience analysing Avaloq requirements for implementation, configuration, customisation, migration, upgrades, and integration.
* Practical understanding of Avaloq processes, product setup, workflows, data structures, interfaces, batch processing, and downstream systems.
* Experience taking Avaloq change requests from initial analysis through development, testing, implementation, and post-release support.
* Experience writing Avaloq functional specifications, technical requirements, interface definitions, data mappings, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience assessing the impact of Avaloq changes across connected systems, reporting, operations, controls, and regulatory processes.
* Experience working on major Avaloq implementation, migration, upgrade, or transformation programmes.
* Experience working with Avaloq vendors and understanding vendor standards, release processes, product constraints, and technical dependencies.
* Experience supporting functional, integration, regression, migration, and user acceptance testing for Avaloq solutions.
* Experience analysing defects and incidents involving Avaloq configuration, custom code, interfaces, data, or business processes.
* Experience with data migration, reconciliation, data quality, and migration validation in an Avaloq environment.
* Knowledge of transactional banking, securities, OTC trading, finance, lombard lending, and Private Bank products is an advantage.
* Understanding of banking controls, operational risk, regulatory requirements, and audit expectations.
* Ability to work with stakeholders across several banking domains.
* Ability to communicate clearly with business users, product owners, developers, testers, architects, vendors, and control functions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis and downstream impact assessment.
* Strong documentation and workshop facilitation skills.
* Ability to prioritise changing requirements and make pragmatic decisions.
* Ability to explain complex Avaloq, banking, data, and integration topics clearly in writing and verbally.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Vice President, POM Product Owner
description:
**Job Description**
Vice President, POM Product Owner
  
  
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, POM Product Owner to join our Payments Enablement Platform Data Services Group. This role is located in Pune.
  
  
**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**

* Focus on detailed business, system, and process analysis within the Payments Enablement Platform Data Services Group. Data Services’ mission is to be the single authoritative source of payments information to internal and external clients that is simplified, stable, controlled and scalable.
* Partner closely with a Data Services Product Owner and support the Product Manager as needed—to translate product intent, regulatory needs, and operational requirements into clear, testable analysis and backlog‑ready stories. This role is accountable for improving story quality, reducing ambiguity and rework, and supporting audit‑ and operations‑ready delivery.
* Elicit, analyze, and document functional and non‑functional requirements (including regulatory, control, resiliency, data, and operational considerations) for Payments Data Services.
* Create and maintain analysis artifacts: current‑ and future‑state process flows, user journeys, decision tables, data mappings, and traceability.
* Support backlog readiness and refinement with the Product Owner; clarify scope, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and downstream impacts for delivery teams.
* Conduct impact analysis across adjacent workflows, systems, and controls; surface risks, dependencies, and operational constraints early.
* Partner with testing to validate requirements and acceptance criteria; support UAT and defect triage from a business‑process perspective.
* Maintain regulatory and audit traceability from requirements through release, ensuring required evidence and documentation are complete.
* Contribute to launch and BAU handover by preparing process updates, standard operating procedures/work‑instructions, RACI updates, and training materials in partnership with Product and Operations.
* Surface when analysis complexity, regulatory risk, or cross‑pod dependencies exceed pod scope and require support.

**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**
*Education & Experience*

* Bachelor’s degree or work experience equivalent
* 5+ years of overall experience, some of which was in transaction banking, with at least 2 years in a Product Owner, or Business Analyst role.

*Domain Expertise*

* Payments Data Domain Knowledge

+ Strong grasp of payment processing workflows, including instruction enrichment, validation, and routing logic.
+ Knowledge of transaction classification, foreign exchange determination, and cut-off/value date logic.
+ Awareness of messaging standards (e.g., ISO 20022, SWIFT MT) and regulatory frameworks (e.g., AML, PSD2, FATF).

* Data Architecture & Platform Familiarity

+ Experience working with data lakes, cloud-based data platforms, and enterprise data warehouses.
+ Understanding of ETL/ELT processes, event-driven architectures, and streaming data pipelines.
+ Ability to collaborate with engineering teams on data modeling, schema design, and data integration.

* Data Stewardship & Collaboration

+ Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams to define data requirements, prioritize datasets, and resolve data gaps.
+ Experience in data lifecycle management, including ingestion, transformation, and distribution.
+ Comfort with data audit processes, critical control identification, and risk mitigation.

* Analytics & Decision Support

+ Strong analytical skills to interpret data trends, monitor performance, and inform product decisions.
+ Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and SQL-based analysis.
+ Ability to translate business needs into data-driven user stories and acceptance criteria.

* Data Governance & Quality

+ Understanding of data governance principles
+ Ability to define and enforce data quality rules, monitor data integrity, and manage remediation workflows.
+ Familiarity with metadata management, data lineage, and data cataloging

*Product Ownership & Agile Skills*

* Experience in Agile/Scrum environments, with a solid grasp of Agile principles, ceremonies and backlog prioritization/management.
* Ability to write clear and actionable user stories, define acceptance criteria, and manage a product backlog.
* Strong stakeholder management skills — capable of balancing the needs of operations, compliance, IT, and clients.
* Experience collaborating with development teams, testers, and business SMEs to deliver high-quality solutions.

*Technical & Analytical and Artificial Intelligence Skills*

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to work cross-functionally across business and technical teams.
* Ability to analyze trends and use data to inform product decisions and drive operational efficiency.
* Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, Excel, and data visualization tools.
* Proficient in the use of AI and its applicability to Payments Data Services.

**Soft Skills & Other Qualities**

* Strong communication and documentation skills — able to translate complex payment processes into business and technical requirements.
* High attention to detail, especially in compliance- and risk-sensitive environments.
* Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-pressure setting.
* Comfortable working in a global, cross-functional team and across different time zones

**About Us**
At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.
  
  
Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.
  
  
**About The Team**
At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn
  
  
**Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards**

* America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
* World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
* “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

**Our Benefits And Rewards**
BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

JOB Description: Claims BA

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse end-to-end claims adjudication workflows, including claim intake, validation, pricing, edits, benefits application, payment, and denial processes.
* Gather and document business requirements for claims processing system enhancements.
* Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, and process flows.
* Evaluate claim processing rules, benefit plans, fee schedules, provider contracts, and reimbursement methodologies.
* Support implementation of new claim edits, policies, and regulatory changes.
* Identify operational gaps and recommend automation opportunities.
* Perform root cause analysis for claim payment issues, pended claims, and adjudication defects.
* Analyze denial trends, provider disputes, and payment accuracy metrics.
* Improve turnaround time (TAT), first-pass auto-adjudication rates, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with Claims Operations, Configuration, Provider Network, Compliance, and IT teams.
* Facilitate requirement workshops and stakeholder meetings.
* Provide business support during project implementation and production deployments.
* Develop test scenarios and test cases.
* Execute and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Validate claims adjudication outcomes against business requirements.
* Track defects and coordinate resolution with development teams

**Domain and Business analysis Skills**

* Healthcare, Dental, Medicare, Medicaid, or Commercial Claims Processing.
* Claims lifecycle management.
* Claims adjudication rules and payment methodologies.
* Provider contracts and fee schedules.
* Benefits, eligibility, COB, and authorization processes.
* Medical coding (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS) and/or Dental Coding (CDT Codes)
* Requirement Gathering
* Process Mapping
* Gap Analysis / Root Cause Analysis
* UAT Planning and Execution
* Preferred knowledge different claims processing platforms

**Qualification**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or related field.
* 4-10 years of experience in healthcare or Medical / dental claims processing/business analysis.
* Strong understanding of claims adjudication systems and payer operations.
* Preferred with BA Role Experience

- Effective communication of complex issues and results to diverse audiences.

- Experience:
- Several years of practical experience and solid domain know-how in Accounting, Tax, and/or Treasury (absolute must).
- Proven experience in end-to-end process consulting, spanning from analysis and design to implementation, testing, and rollout support.
- Technical Knowledge & Skills:
- Strong background in tool-agnostic business process analysis and design, combined with a solid understanding of financial system environments (familiarity with SAP FI/CO concepts and/or other ERP’s).
- Solid understanding of cross-functional integration (e.g., Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report) and Financial Performance Management (FPM) / consolidation solutions.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Location Name:**
Pune Corporate Office - Mantri
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To provide PMO governance and operational coordination for the IT Compliance and ServiceNow GRC/IRM vertical by enabling structured planning, accurate reporting, risk and issue visibility, timely stakeholder follow-up, audit readiness, and closure of compliance actions and platform initiatives.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
Own and maintain the integrated PMO plan for IT Compliance and ServiceNow GRC/IRM initiatives, including milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions and action items.
  
  

* Prepare weekly and monthly governance dashboards, MIS, management presentations and executive summaries covering project status, compliance posture, control performance, audit observations, remediation progress and overdue actions.
* Coordinate governance forums with IT Compliance, risk, audit, information security, ServiceNow platform, business and technology teams; prepare agendas and minutes and track decisions and actions to closure.
* Monitor policy, control, risk, issue, exception, evidence and remediation records in ServiceNow GRC/IRM and follow up with accountable owners to maintain completeness, accuracy and timeliness.
* Support internal audits, external audits, regulatory reviews and control assessments by coordinating evidence requests, validating submission status and maintaining audit-ready documentation and traceability.
* Track ServiceNow GRC enhancements, defects, change requests, UAT, releases and production issues; coordinate priorities, dependencies and closure with functional, technical and support teams.
* Identify schedule slippages, recurring gaps, data-quality concerns and unresolved dependencies; escalate them through the defined governance mechanism with clear impact and required decisions.
* Drive standardization and continuous improvement of PMO and compliance processes, trackers, reports, dashboards and workflow automation while ensuring adherence to change and governance requirements.

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**
Determine the appropriate governance tracker, reporting format, review cadence and escalation route within approved PMO standards.
  
  

* Validate the completeness and consistency of status updates, evidence references, action plans and management reports before circulation.
* Prioritize follow-ups based on compliance impact, audit commitment, risk severity, ageing, dependency and target date.
* Recommend process, dashboard and workflow improvements to strengthen visibility, control and operational efficiency.
* Escalate material delays, control gaps, audit risks, data-quality concerns and unresolved cross-functional dependencies to the relevant lead.

**Major Challenges**
Consolidating accurate and timely information from multiple stakeholders, systems and compliance workstreams for management reporting.
  
  

* Maintaining alignment between business compliance requirements, ServiceNow GRC workflows, audit commitments and technology delivery timelines.
* Driving closure of overdue actions and remediation items where ownership, evidence, dependencies or priorities span multiple functions.
* Ensuring data quality, traceability and audit readiness across policies, controls, risks, issues, exceptions and remediation records.
* Balancing recurring governance activities with enhancement delivery, UAT, release coordination and production issue follow-up.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
Educational Qualifications Graduate degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Administration or equivalent. PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, ISO 27001, CISA, CRISC or ServiceNow GRC/IRM certification will be an added advantage.
  
  
Experience 4-7 years of relevant experience in PMO, IT compliance, IT governance, risk management, audit coordination or ServiceNow GRC/IRM. Experience in a regulated enterprise environment will be preferred.
  
  
Core Functional / Technical Skills PMO governance, project and action tracking, risk and issue management, audit and evidence coordination, control and remediation tracking, ServiceNow GRC/IRM concepts, dashboards and MIS, advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, and working knowledge of reporting and data analysis.
  
  
Additional Skills Understanding of ITGC, policy and compliance management, control testing, issue and exception management, third-party risk, regulatory compliance, UAT, release/change coordination and ServiceNow reports and dashboards. Basic knowledge of Power BI, Visio or automation tools will be an added advantage.
  
  
Behavioral Competencies Strong ownership and follow-through, structured analytical thinking, attention to detail, stakeholder management, clear written and verbal communication, ability to manage competing priorities, professional judgement, collaboration, problem solving and timely escalation.

Purplle is more than a beauty e-commerce destination; we are a technology-first platform redefining how digital scale is managed. We are currently in a transformative phase, moving from “manual intervention and firefighting” to an era of Systematic Resilience.
  
  
Our mission is to build “Unbreakable Systems”—platforms that don’t just survive failures but absorb them, self-heal, and scale with the business calmly and predictably. We are looking for engineers who want to stop “fixing” and start “architecting” at the highest level.
  
  
THE PURPLLE WAY: AI-NATIVE ENGINEERING

* Intelligence by Default (Zero-Toil Operations): We embed AI across the entire lifecycle—Build,Test, Detect, and Operate. By utilizing AI agents to eliminate “Ops Toil,” we’ve created an environment where anomaly detection and incident diagnosis happen in minutes, not hours.
* Predictable Economics & Growth: We treat cloud costs and system performance as core engineering disciplines. Every engineer at Purplle understands the “unit economics” of their code, ensuring our infrastructure scales as efficiently as our business.

THE PURPLLE ENGINEER: MINDSET & IMPACT
  
  
We Aren’t Looking For “feature Factories”; We Are Looking For Owners Of a Resilient Ecosystem. At Purplle, Your Success Is Defined By Your Mindset And The Tangible Impact You Have On Our Platform
  
  
The Systems Thinker (Quality & Resilience): You hate fixing the same bug twice. You’d rather build a “self-healing” mechanism than perform a manual fix. Your goal is to maintain a Change Failure Rate of <1.5% and help us reach a state of fewer than 2 Sev-1 incidents per quarter. You leverage these tools to drive a cycle time of <4 hours and maintain a high frequency of dailydeployments, moving code from commit to production with total confidence.- The Data-Informed Engineer (Economic Discipline): You care about the “why” behind the code. YOUR SPECIFIC MANDATE

* AI-Native Velocity: Lead the 70% AI-assisted PR mandate by mastering Cursor, Copilot, and Claude to accelerate delivery of Node.js (NestJS) and Golang microservices—while keeping human intelligence focused on high-level system design and architecture decisions.

* API & Service Design Excellence: Build clean, versioned, and backward-compatible APIs and modular microservices with a strong focus on maintainability, scalability, and clear service contracts.

* Scalability & Cost Efficiency: Continuously optimize system throughput, fault tolerance, and infrastructure utilization to support high growth while maintaining strict control over cloud costs.
* Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Lead design decisions, write clear RFCs, mentor engineers, and collaborate closely with Product, Frontend, Data, and DevOps teams to drive high-quality outcomes.
* Core Engineering Excellence: Apply strong fundamentals in distributed systems, concurrency, and data structures, combined with sharp problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.

TECH STACK
  
  

* Languages & Frameworks: Node.js (NestJS / Express), Golang
* Data & Messaging: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Aerospike, ElasticSearch
* Infrastructure: Kubernetes, GCP / AWS, Docker

Software Engineer (Full Stack)
  
  
Maersk is hiring Software Engineers who can work across the stack to join the Visibility Platform team. The platform answers the questions "where is my shipment?" and "when will I get it?" with a high level of accuracy and timeliness. It is powered by tons of data from multiple sources, and this role provides an opportunity to innovate on how the right subset of that data is processed, served and presented to users in the right context.
  
  
**About The Role**
In this role, you will work on a greenfield project that aims to provide increased quality of visibility into the movements of containerised shipments and associated attributes like delays, extra charges incurred, emissions, etc.
  
  
You will lead and own the features you pick up from first prototype to production, working across the tech stack. You will move comfortably between the front-end and the back-end, using modern coding agents to move fast and teammates for review and guidance.
  
  
Here are some of the things the role involves:
  
  

* Independently lead and own the design, delivery and long-term health of the features and services you build.
* Contribute freely to both the web front-end and the back-end services, using coding agents to explore unfamiliar code, produce working changes, and learn conventions as you go. Take responsibility for what you ship, regardless of who or what wrote the first draft.
* Work closely with the UX and product team to iterate and provide feedback on mocks and designs and how well they solve user problems.
* Build quick prototypes for exploring concepts. Be happy to throw some away and evolve others into solutions that are maintainable for a long time.
* Work backwards from the mocks and help design API structures that can power the views in an efficient and performant manner. Where existing APIs can be limiting, help explore alternate options in design that don't degrade the originally intended user experience.
* While building views, care deeply about semantic HTML, accessibility and rendering

performance, often with each going hand-in-hand with the other.
  
  

* While building services, build event driven applications and microservice-based APIs with a lot of focus on scalability, reliability and secure practices from the ground up.
* Work with Maersk's design system conventions and ensure consistency in design language across multiple micro-applications. Know when the conventions can be limiting and be comfortable stepping out of them.
* Ensure hygiene practices like test coverage, performance profiling, security checks etc. are put in place and gated with automated checks.
* Ensure applications emit the standard signals needed for effective monitoring and alerting.
* Actively participate in code reviews and encourage using them as a tool for team members to learn from each other. Review agent-assisted changes with the same rigour as any other.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous delivery where the path from code commit to going live is as automated as it can be.
* Work in an inclusive manner with team members across geographies, time zones and cultures.

**About You**
Here are some things we expect from you for the role.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Be highly proficient with either the back-end or the front-end, as described below. This is the minimum bar, and you should be able to independently lead and own delivery of major components, pages or services there with very little hand-holding.
* Back-end: Java or Kotlin and a framework like Spring Boot, with experience building event driven applications and microservice-based APIs that handle a huge amount of data.
* Front-end: Vue, React, Svelte or Angular, TypeScript, semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive design. We mainly use Vue, so be open to it.
* Be able to contribute across the other side with the help of coding agents: enough familiarity to read the code, judge what an agent produces, write and run tests, and know when to ask a teammate for a second pair of eyes.
* Be adept at using modern LLM-based coding agents (like Claude Code or GitHub Copilot) to increase quality and speed of work, including giving them good context, verifying their output,and recognising when they are going wrong.
* Be highly proficient with a test framework like JUnit or Jest, and be a natural at always

maintaining high test coverage for any code written.
  
  

* Be familiar with analysing the algorithmic complexity of code, common design patterns and when to use them.
* Be familiar with at least one relational and one NoSQL database, and with observability concepts: logging, metrics, traces and alerts.
* Be familiar with cloud computing concepts and able to put them into practice, with experience in at least one of Azure, Google Cloud or AWS.
* Be familiar with a build system like Webpack, and with Node.js and the npm ecosystem. Be aware of common reusable open-source libraries, and mindful of not causing bloated dependencies.
* Be open to deep dives into new areas of the tech stack and learn new skills on the go.
* Be a stickler for developer productivity, and always be on the lookout to get things done more efficiently.
* Be effective at written and spoken communication. Also exhibit the same in writing code that can be well understood by other developers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Be highly proficient on both sides: the back-end and the front-end described above, rather than one with agent-assisted contribution to the other.
* Be familiar with browser-based testing frameworks like Cypress to automate end-to-end user workflow tests, and with Core Web Vitals and how to build pages that render blazing fast, with measurements set up to be monitored continuously.
* Have an eye for extracting patterns for reusability that help ensure consistency across multiple applications.
* Previous experience working with visual elements like maps and charts that help display a massive amount of data in aggregated form.
* Prior experience working with Kafka, or with containerised 12-factor apps and tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge about the logistics and supply chain domain.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We're hiring an SDE-2 Full Stack Engineer to build the web experiences adjusters and policyholders use to report, track, and settle insurance claims. You'll spend most of your time on the frontend in React and TypeScript — owning features end to end from design handoff to production — while understanding and contributing to the backend services that power them.
  
  
Our claims services are written largely in Go, so Go experience is a strong plus, though solid backend fundamentals in any language are what matter most. We're also building a desktop application in Electron, so Electron experience is a real plus. You'll design APIs alongside backend engineers, reason about data models, and understand how your UI behaves under real production load.
  
  
This is a mid-level role for someone who ships independently, raises the bar on frontend quality, and wants to learn the claims domain deeply. The people using what you build are often filing a claim on a bad day or working through a high-volume queue — thoughtful, reliable UX matters here.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Frontend features across the claims lifecycle: claim intimation, claim status tracking, document and photo upload, adjuster workbench tools, and settlement flows
* Translating designs into accessible, responsive, performant UI, and partnering with design and product on usability
* API design with backend engineers, and contributions to Go services when a feature needs an endpoint, a data model change, or a fix
* Integrations with third-party vendor APIs — surveyors, garages/repairers, hospitals or TPAs, payment gateways, document verification — including error handling, retries, and graceful degradation when a vendor is slow or down
* Frontend observability: error tracking, performance monitoring, user-journey analytics, and alerting so we know when a claims flow breaks before customers tell us
* Test coverage and observability for everything you ship — unit, integration, and end-to-end

**Who You Are**

* You take a feature from ambiguous requirement to production without waiting to be told each step
* You explain technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers, product, and design, in writing and in conversation
* You debug across the stack — browser, API, database — and fix root causes, not symptoms
* You review others' code generously, ask for review on your own, and help junior engineers level up

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on frontend development
* Strong command of React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, including state management, component architecture, and performance tuning
* Solid HTML/CSS fundamentals, hands-on Tailwind CSS experience, accessibility (WCAG) awareness, and experience building responsive, cross-browser UI
* Working knowledge of backend systems: REST or gRPC API design, relational databases and SQL, authentication/authorization, and how services are deployed and monitored
* Hands-on backend experience in at least one server-side language (Go preferred; Java, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar also fine)
* Experience writing automated tests at multiple levels
* Experience integrating third-party APIs into a product, and instrumenting frontend code with error tracking and performance monitoring

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building or shipping Electron desktop applications: packaging, auto-updates, main/renderer process communication, and native OS integration
* Production experience with Go: writing services, concurrency patterns, testing, and the standard toolchain
* Experience in another regulated domain (fintech, healthcare, banking) where auditability, data privacy, and compliance shape product decisions
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures, message queues, or workflow engines
* Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containers, and CI/CD
* Exposure to applied AI/ML features in product — document classification, intake triage, or LLM-backed assistants

Skills:- React.js, tailwindcss, Go Programming (Golang), NodeJS (Node.js), Python and TypeScript

title: Accountant
description:
**Job Title: Accountant**  AP, AR & General Ledger

**Location:** Pune, India (Viman Nagar)  
**Experience:** 5 to 7 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Joining Preference:** Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period less than 30 days.  
**Working Hours:** Flexible business hours (11 AM to 8 PM or 12PM to 9PM IST) / depending on business requirements.

**Department:** Finance & Accounting

**Work from Office** - 5 Days work from Office, no work from Home.

**Company-provided transport -** No

  
  
  

**Role & responsibilities**

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented **Accountant** to join our finance team in Pune GSC and manage the end-to-end accounting and financial reporting activities of an Foreign-based entity.

This is a versatile, hands-on role offering ownership of the entitys accounting operations, covering Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), statutory compliance, budgeting, performance reporting, and audit coordination.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working independently, managing multiple finance activities, coordinating with international stakeholders, and ensuring accurate, timely and compliant financial reporting.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Accounts Payable (AP)**

* Manage the complete accounts payable cycle, including vendor invoice verification, coding, posting, and payment preparation.
* Review vendor statements, resolve discrepancies and ensure timely settlement of supplier balances.
* Monitor payment terms, outstanding liabilities, and vendor reconciliations.
* Ensure appropriate supporting documentation and approval controls are in place for all payments.

**2. Accounts Receivable (AR)**

* Oversee customer invoicing, cash application, receipt allocation, and customer account reconciliations.
* Monitor outstanding receivables, overdue balances, and ageing reports.
* Coordinate with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve billing and payment discrepancies.
* Support collection follow-ups and provide regular updates on receivables and cash-flow positions.

**3. General Ledger, Closing & Audit**

* Perform and oversee General Ledger (GL) accounting, including journal entries, account reviews, and month-end close activities.
* Prepare, review, and maintain balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring timely resolution of outstanding items.
* Coordinate internal and external audits, including preparation of audit schedules, supporting documents and responses to auditor queries.
* Ensure the timely completion of statutory and group reporting requirements.
* Maintain audit-ready accounting records and follow up on audit observations and corrective actions.

**4. End-to-End Accounting & Entity Ownership**

* Take ownership of the entitys day-to-day accounting operations and ensure accurate and timely financial records.
* Manage the complete accounting cycle, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, provisions, fixed assets, and balance-sheet reconciliations.
* Perform month-end and year-end closing activities in accordance with applicable accounting standards and group reporting requirements.
* Review general ledger balances, investigate variances and resolve outstanding reconciliation items.
* Maintain proper documentation, internal controls, and compliance with group finance policies.

**5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Possess sound working knowledge of GST/VAT, including applicable compliance requirements, reconciliations, and return support.
* Understand TDS / withholding tax principles, including applicable deductions, documentation, reconciliations, and reporting requirements.
* Support tax filings, statutory audits, and other compliance activities in coordination with tax advisors or consultants.

**6. Budgeting, MIS & Performance Reporting**

* Assist in preparing annual budgets, periodic forecasts, and financial projections.
* Prepare monthly management reports covering revenue, costs, profitability, budget-versus-actual performance, and key variances.
* Investigate significant variances and provide meaningful explanations and actionable insights to management.
* Support cash-flow forecasting, working-capital monitoring, and financial performance analysis.
* Ensure accurate and timely submission of financial data to the group finance and controlling teams.

**7. International Stakeholder Coordination**

* Work closely with the Foreign-based finance team and other international stakeholders to meet reporting deadlines.
* Communicate effectively on accounting queries, reconciliations, closing activities, and financial performance.
* Adapt to European business hours and reporting deadlines as required.
* Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.

  

**Perks and benefits**

* Competitive compensation package.
* Employee medical insurance.
* Personal accident insurance.
* Opportunity to work with an international finance team and gain exposure to Foreign accounting and reporting.
